market_outlook.short_term: Cautiously constructive. JPMorgan sees rotation-driven gains. Warsh hawkish tone may pressure rates-sensitive sectors but supports gold/short-duration. Apple transition (Sept 1) and Humana Medicare cuts (Oct) create event risk. CD rates at 4.30% attractive. Bitcoin volatile around $81K. Expect choppy but upward-biased tape with narrow leadership.
market_outlook.long_term: Structurally positive but concentration risk is the dominant concern. AI capex cycle may decelerate (Brown's warning), favoring beneficiaries over infrastructure. EM rotation into Asian semis is a 12-month theme. Inflation stickiness limits multiple expansion. Venezuela oil deal strengthens US energy position long-term. Healthcare and cybersecurity offer secular growth. Consumer pressure (grocery +5.9%) caps discretionary upside.
